# AgentKit Drawer

> Tested rules packs and prompt templates that keep AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf) on track for a specific stack. One-time purchase, instant download, use in unlimited personal and commercial projects, 14-day refund.

Support: agentkitdrawer@agentmail.to. Newsletter: signup form on every page. Free samples are MIT-licensed on GitHub: https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer

## Packs
- [Vibe Starter Rules Pack](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drw-01) (DRW-01, $19): Rules for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) on Next.js App Router + Supabase + Stripe: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, 8 scoped .cursor/rules (auth, RLS, Stripe webhooks, env/secrets, tests, UI), 12 slash-command prompts, 2 launch checklists.
- [Game Jam Agent Kit](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drw-02) (DRW-02, $24): AGENTS.md and rules for Godot 4 (GDScript) and Phaser game jams: scope control, InputMap-only input, @export feel numbers, jam timeline, prompts for prototyping and polish.
- [Agent Builder Prompt Pack](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drw-03) (DRW-03, $29): 10 production system-prompt templates for AI agents (PR reviewer, support triage, researcher, SQL analyst, docs Q&A and more), guardrail snippets, and 100 eval cases with a runner for any OpenAI-compatible API.
- [Claude Code Kit](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drw-04) (DRW-04, $24): Claude Code setup: CLAUDE.md, 6 least-privilege subagents (planner, code-reviewer, test-writer, debugger, security-auditor, docs-writer), 10 slash commands, settings.json permissions and 4 hooks (block dangerous Bash, protect secrets and lockfiles, auto-format, tests before stop).
- [Python/FastAPI Backend Kit](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#drw-05) (DRW-05, $19): AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, 8 scoped .cursor/rules and 10 prompts for FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 + Pydantic v2 + Alembic + pytest: ownership checks, migrations, security and testing rules, plus definition-of-done and pre-deploy checklists.
- [The Whole Cabinet](https://agentkitdrawer.com/#bundle) (BUNDLE, $49): DRW-01 to DRW-03 plus 12 months of updates. Saves $23.

## Free files
- [nextjs-supabase-rls.mdc](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/nextjs-supabase-rls.mdc): Cursor rule enforcing Supabase row-level security
- [godot-jam-timeline.md](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/godot-jam-timeline.md): 48-hour Godot jam timeline for agents
- [agents-md-game-modding.md](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/agents-md-game-modding.md): AGENTS.md template for Minecraft/Godot/Unity mods and small game tools
- [agent-guardrails.md](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/agentkit-drawer/blob/main/free/agent-guardrails.md): Guardrail snippets for any system prompt
